intro.h2: Condo remodeling in Chicago, planned around your building's rules
paragraphs: Condo remodeling in Chicago is mostly about the building. Before a wall comes down there is an alteration agreement, insurance certificates, elevator bookings and work-hour rules. Assembly Squad has handled that paperwork since 2013, and today 75% of its completed projects are condominium renovations.

The firm is a licensed design-build general contractor, so one team covers design, permits, materials, construction and the final walkthrough. You meet your designer at the Lincoln Park studio, pick real materials, and get a fixed-price proposal. Then a dedicated project manager runs the job and sends daily photo updates while you get on with your week.

services.h2: What we renovate in Chicago homes and condos

items.name: Condo Remodeling
items.blurb: Gut renovations and single-room updates in high-rises, lofts and greystone conversions. The team prepares alteration agreements, insurance certificates, drawings, neighbor notices and board presentations, then works within building hours. Typical condo budgets run $25,000 to $250,000+, depending on scope.

image.alt: Galley kitchen remodel at The Chandler, 450 E Waterside Dr, Lakeshore East Chicago, with white shaker cabinets, quartz counters and breakfast bar with city view

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling
items.blurb: Custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, new appliances and full layout changes for condos, two-flats and single-family homes. Kitchens are the firm's most requested service, with typical budgets from $25,000 to $150,000+. You see 3D renderings and choose every material before construction starts.

image.alt: Bucktown kitchen remodel at 1757 N Paulina St with two-tone green and cream cabinetry, Calacatta quartz and fluted tile backsplash

items.name: Bathroom Renovation
items.blurb: Walk-in shower conversions, custom vanities, heated floors and tile work designed around condo plumbing stacks and building waterproofing rules. Bathroom budgets typically run $15,000 to $55,000. Recent work includes lofts in the West Loop and high-rise units in Lakeshore East.

image.alt: Bathroom renovation at Gotham Lofts, 420 S Clinton, West Loop Chicago, with oak double vanity, brass mirrors and stone top

items.name: Basement Finishing
items.blurb: Family rooms, home offices, wet bars, ADUs and legal rental units, with waterproofing included in the scope. Typical basement budgets run $30,000 to $100,000+. Permits and inspections are part of every project, so you are not left dealing with the city alone.

image.alt: Lincoln Park basement remodel in Chicago finished as an entertainment suite

items.name: Whole Home Renovation
items.blurb: Complete gut rehabs covering the kitchen, every bathroom, flooring, plumbing and electrical. The team works on Chicago greystones, vintage two-flats, single-family homes and condo conversions, and as an EPA Lead-Safe Certified Firm it can work in pre-1978 homes. Typical budgets start around $85,000.

image.alt: Wicker Park whole-home remodel in Chicago, kitchen with navy island, stainless steel appliances and gold accents

items.name: Illinois-Made Custom Cabinets
items.blurb: Since 2024 the firm has offered Illinois-made custom cabinetry for kitchens, baths and built-ins. Lead times run 4 to 6 weeks instead of the 16 weeks the firm saw on imports, with no tariff exposure. Full-size displays are open to see at the Lincoln Park studio.

image.alt: Wicker Park kitchen in Chicago after a full gut remodel, with custom cabinets in an open-concept layout

about.h2: Founded by Viktor Aharon after 22+ years in remodeling
about.text: Viktor Aharon spent more than 22 years in remodeling watching homeowners juggle contractors, chase permit updates and make decisions nobody prepared them for. In 2011 he built the first Assembly Squad as an app to help people plan and manage a renovation. By 2013 it had become a design-build general contracting company with one rule: one team, one contract, one fixed price. Viktor asks whether you are building a forever home or planning a five or six year stay, then plans the work to balance daily enjoyment with resale value.

image.alt: Viktor Aharon, founder and CEO of Assembly Squad Remodeling in Chicago

steps.title: Week 1: Free consultation
steps.text: The team visits your home or condo, reviews building requirements and talks through your plans. A detailed estimate follows within 48 hours, in person or virtual.

steps.title: Weeks 2 to 4: Design and approvals
steps.text: 3D renderings, material picks at the Lincoln Park studio and a fixed-price proposal, while the firm handles HOA paperwork, permits and landmark approvals.

steps.title: Weeks 4 to 12: Construction
steps.text: Crews work within building hours, coordinate elevators and keep the site clean. Your project manager sends daily photo updates.

steps.title: Final week: Walkthrough
steps.text: A punch-list inspection, touch-ups and your warranty paperwork, including the 2-year workmanship warranty on all Assembly Squad labor.

service_area.h2: Chicago neighborhoods and North Shore towns we serve
service_area.text: Assembly Squad works across Chicago, the North Shore and nearby suburbs, roughly 40 miles out from the Loop. Downtown and Near North jobs are mostly high-rise condos and lofts. West and Northwest Side work leans toward two-flats, bungalows and loft conversions. On the North Shore the team builds premium kitchens, primary baths and basements. Every area gets the same free consultation and fixed-price proposal.

items.q: Who deals with my condo board and building management?
items.a: Assembly Squad does. HOA coordination is included on every condo project: alteration agreements, certificates of insurance, architectural drawings, neighbor notifications and board presentations. The firm is pre-approved in 300+ Chicago buildings and says it has had zero HOA complaints in 13 years. Call (312) 544-9150 to check whether your building is on the list.

items.q: What does a condo kitchen or bathroom cost in Chicago?
items.a: The firm publishes typical ranges: $25,000 to $150,000+ for kitchens, $15,000 to $55,000 for bathrooms and $25,000 to $250,000+ for condo remodels, with full condo gut renovations often at the high end. Your exact number comes in a fixed-price proposal after design, and the first estimate is free.

items.q: How long will my renovation take?
items.a: The standard plan runs about twelve weeks. Week one is the consultation and estimate, weeks two to four cover design, HOA paperwork and permits, and construction runs from week four to week twelve. City permit processing typically takes two to three weeks and is built into that schedule.

items.q: Can I see materials before I sign?
items.a: Yes. The Lincoln Park design studio at 2315 N Southport Ave is a 2,500 sq ft showroom with 500+ cabinet finishes, countertop slabs, tile, hardware and flooring samples. It is open Monday to Friday 9 am to 6 pm and Saturday 10 am to 4 pm by appointment, and 3D renderings are free.

items.q: Do you work outside the city?
items.a: Yes. Since 2025 the firm has brought the same design-build service to the North Shore, including Winnetka, Lake Forest, Highland Park, Glencoe and Evanston. It also works in suburbs such as Hinsdale, Glenview and Arlington Heights, within about 40 miles of the Loop, with the same free in-home consultation.

final_cta.h2: Ready to talk about your building and your plans?
final_cta.text: Call Viktor's team at (312) 544-9150 for a free consultation, or visit the Lincoln Park studio by appointment.
